collection.title: Baby Furniture - Cribs, Nursery & Kids Room Essentials
collection.body_html:
Baby Furniture for Every Nursery

Furnishing a nursery requires careful consideration of safety, functionality, and design. Our baby furniture collection includes essential pieces that grow with your child, from newborn through toddler years.

Cribs & Toddler Beds

Choose from convertible cribs that transform into toddler beds, standard cribs with adjustable mattress heights, and mini cribs for smaller spaces. All cribs meet current safety standards with non-toxic finishes and sturdy construction.

Changing Tables & Dressers

Changing tables with safety rails and storage compartments keep diapers and essentials within reach. Nursery dressers double as changing stations with removable toppers, providing long-term value as your child grows.

Storage Solutions

Bookcases, toy chests, and storage bins help organize the nursery. Look for pieces with rounded edges, tip-over protection, and finishes that coordinate with your nursery theme.

Safety & Quality Standards

All baby furniture should comply with CPSC and ASTM safety standards. Check for GREENGUARD Gold certification for low chemical emissions, solid wood construction for durability, and hardware that prevents tipping or collapse.

Choosing the Right Pieces

Measure your nursery space before purchasing. Consider convertible furniture that adapts as your child grows. Match finishes across pieces for a cohesive look, or mix natural wood tones for an eclectic style.
